_doc: In-repo MIRROR of the Drive SSOT 'Writerly Moves — Move Bible v1' LOCKED naming decisions. CI cannot reach Drive live, so this committed snapshot is what canon-guard --vocab enforces the game builds against: a RETIRED card name appearing in a build is drift from the SSOT and HALTs. This is the automated half of the Drive->build coupling; the REFRESH half (re-mirror when the Bible changes) is a chat/cowork step — see refresh below.

source.note: The Move Bible is the single source of truth for the deck vocabulary, grounded in the EN210 Storyscape / Drafty Air / Honne & Tatemae class materials.

_scope_note: Start scoped to the-tell.html (reconciled + verified 2026-07-27). Add a game build to scope_globs only after its card names are reconciled to canon — the ratchet: enforce where verified, not blindly. The guard matches a retired alias only as a CARD NAME (n:'ALIAS' in the deck, or >ALIAS< as visible text), never in prose/comments, so a provenance note that mentions the old name does not trip it.
refresh: When the Move Bible changes: a Claude session (chat or the weekly Routine, when it has Drive) re-reads the Drive file, updates this mirror's `retired` list + `mirrored` date, and commits. canon-guard --vocab then enforces every build against the new mirror. Automated in code (the guard), refreshed from Drive in chat/cowork.
